title: Explainable Abuse Detection as Intent Classification and Slot Filling
reasoning: The paper focuses on the methodology of explainable abuse detection and introduces the PLEAD dataset. While it identifies 'protected characteristics' such as religion as targets of hate speech, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks. It contains a standard 'Note on Ethics' section regarding annotator welfare, which is excluded by the definition.
